module modified by Simon using JDAPI_LAF on Monday 08 September 2008 15:5:6****************************************************************************
*
* Title: OEQMSTAT
* Author: J.L. Gibson
* Date Written: 14 June 1994
* Oracle Vers. Orig.: 7.0
* Revision History:
*
* Modified By Modified Date Version Description of changes
* ----------------------------------------------------------------
* J.L. Gibson 14 Jun 94 1.0 Initial version
* J.L. Gibson 21 Jun 94 2.0 Added exception
* handling and hint
* clean-up to fix AR#63573.
* Linh Tran 10 Mar 94 2.1 Added online help
*
* Abstract:
*
* This form allows the input of different criteria to execute
* the query. The order number and it's associated information
* is displayed depending on the critia of customer id, order type,
* order status, and from date/to date ranges.
*
* Modules Referenced:
* SRVLIB
*
* Inputs:
*
* Customer Identification - The id of valid customers
* Order Type - The different types of orders
* such as Regular, Custom,
* Transfer, Export, Emergency
* Order Status - The status of the order
* From Date - The start of a date range
* To Date - The end of a date range
*
* Outputs:
*
* Displaying the information for the user based on the criteria
* entered.
*
* Error Conditions:
*
* Validation checking on entered information and navigation
* checks for illegal keys entered.
*
* Assumptions and Limitations:
*
* Validation tables must be populated.
*
* Functional Descriptions:
*
* This form begins with entering either customer_id, order_type,
* order_status, or from_date and to_date. In addition, all of the
* fields can be entered or none of the fields. Upon completion of
* the control block, the query is executed and the order information
* is displayed.
*
****************************************************************************

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_lcl_date date;
 
 cursor sel_stord is
 select su.chapter_id,
 so.contract_id,
 c.customer_id,
 so.week_day,
 --to_char(trunc(v_lcl_date)+so.required_time/24,'mmddyyhh24miss') schedule_date, -- Commented by Kishore on 05/14/2012. IM 8618
 to_char(sysdate+so.required_time/24,'mmddyyhh24miss') schedule_date, -- Added by Kishore on 05/14/2012. IM 8618
 co.consignee_id,
 c.payee_id,
 decode(so.confirm_flag,'Y','HO','OR') order_status,
 decode(sign(nvl(chap.isbt_start_date,v_lcl_date+1)-v_lcl_date),1,'C','I') unit_scheme_type
 from chapters chap,
 consignee co,
 customers c,
 vserv_contracts vc,
 standing_orders so,
 system_users su
 where chap.chapter_id = co.chapter_id
 and v_lcl_date between co.eff_date and nvl(co.term_date,v_lcl_date)
 and co.chapter_id = su.chapter_id
 and co.customer_id = c.customer_id
 and c.chapter_id = su.chapter_id
 and so.consignee_id = co.consignee_id -- Added by Kishore on 05/14/2012. IM 8618 
 and v_lcl_date between so.eff_date and nvl(so.term_date,v_lcl_date)
 --and so.week_day = to_char(sysdate,'DY') -- Commented by Kishore on 05/14/2012. IM 8618
 and so.week_day = to_char(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate), 'DY') -- Added by Kishore on 05/14/2012. IM 8618
 and c.customer_id = vc.customer_id
 and vc.contract_id = so.contract_id
 and so.chapter_id = su.chapter_id
 and v_lcl_date between su.eff_date and nvl(su.term_date,v_lcl_date)
 and su.user_id = LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid
 and exists
 (select 'x' from standing_order_items soi
 where soi.contract_id = so.contract_id
 and soi.chapter_id = so.chapter_id
 and soi.consignee_id = so.consignee_id
 and soi.week_day = so.week_day
 and v_lcl_date between soi.eff_date and
 nvl(soi.term_date,v_lcl_date+1))
 and not exists 
 (select 'x' from orders o
 where o.chapter_id = su.chapter_id
 and o.contract_id = so.contract_id
 and o.standing_order_flag = 'Y'
 --and o.est_arrival_time = trunc(v_lcl_date)+so.required_time/24 -- Commented by Kishore on 05/14/2012. IM 8618
 and o.est_arrival_time = sysdate+so.required_time/24 -- Added by Kishore on 05/14/2012. IM 8618
 and o.order_no like to_char(v_lcl_date,'yyddd-')||'%'
 );
 
 tmp_counter number := 0;
 tot_cursor_rows number := 0;
 
BEGIN 
 :global.msg_display := 'N';
 
 if is_timezone_enabled
 then
 v_lcl_date := Lifetrack_Timezone_Convert.Get_Local_Time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate);
 else
 v_lcl_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 for sel_stord_cnt in sel_stord loop
 tot_cursor_rows := sel_stord%rowcount;
 end loop;
 if tot_cursor_rows <1 
 then
 show_error_dist('1002');
 else
 for sel_stord_rec in sel_stord loop
 tmp_counter := tmp_counter + 1;
 if tmp_counter = tot_cursor_rows then
 :global.msg_display := 'Y';
 end if;
 
 generate_order(sel_stord_rec.chapter_id,
 sel_stord_rec.contract_id,
 sel_stord_rec.customer_id,
 sel_stord_rec.week_day,
 sel_stord_rec.schedule_date,
 sel_stord_rec.consignee_id,
 sel_stord_rec.payee_id,
 sel_stord_rec.order_status,
 sel_stord_rec.unit_scheme_type);
 end loop;
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE GENERATE_ORDER (p_chapter_id IN system_users.chapter_id%TYPE,
 p_contract_id IN standing_orders.contract_id%TYPE,
 p_customer_id IN customers.customer_id%TYPE,
 p_week_day IN standing_orders.week_day%TYPE,
 p_schedule_date IN varchar2,
 p_consignee_id IN consignee.consignee_id%TYPE,
 p_payee_id IN customers.payee_id%TYPE,
 p_order_status IN varchar2,
 p_unit_scheme_type IN varchar2) IS
 
 usr_id varchar2(15);
 g_order_no varchar2(14); 
 fn_rslt varchar2(10);
 v_lcl_date date;
 
BEGIN
 usr_id := name_in('banner.user_id');
 g_order_no := null;
 fn_rslt := gen_order_no(p_chapter_id, g_order_no);
 
 if is_timezone_enabled
 then
 v_lcl_date := Lifetrack_Timezone_Convert.Get_Local_Time(p_chapter_id,sysdate);
 else
 v_lcl_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 
 if (fn_rslt = 'SUCCESS') then
 begin
 insert into orders 
 (order_no,
 chapter_id,
 order_type,
 customer_id,
 contract_id,
 consignee_id,
 payee_id,
 order_status,
 order_class,
 insert_date,
 insert_user_id,
 est_arrival_time,
 last_activity_date,
 standing_order_flag,
 program_id)
 values
 (g_order_no,
 p_chapter_id,
 'RE',
 p_customer_id,
 p_contract_id,
 p_consignee_id,
 p_payee_id,
 p_order_status,
 'SO',
 --v_lcl_date, -- Commented by Kishore on 05/14/2012. IM 8618
 sysdate, -- Added by Kishore on 05/14/2012. IM 8618
 substr(usr_id,instr(usr_id,'$')+1), 
 to_date(p_schedule_date,'mmddyyhh24miss'),
 --v_lcl_date, -- Commented by Kishore on 05/14/2012. IM 8618
 sysdate, -- Added by Kishore on 05/14/2012. IM 8618
 'Y',
 'OEBSTORD');
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 begin 
 insert into order_items ( 
 order_no,
 chapter_id,
 item_no,
 blood_type,
 required_qty,
 canceled_qty,
 item_status,
 product_type,
 tier,
 allocated_qty,
 shipped_qty,
 sub_ok,
 program_id)
 select g_order_no,
 soi.chapter_id,
 soi.item_no,
 soi.blood_type,
 soi.qty,
 0,
 'OR',
 soi.product_type,
 soi.tier,
 0,
 0,
 soi.sub_ok,
 'OEBSTORD'
 from standing_order_items soi
 where soi.week_day = p_week_day
 and soi.chapter_id = p_chapter_id
 and soi.contract_id = p_contract_id
 and soi.consignee_id = p_consignee_id
 and v_lcl_date between soi.eff_date 
 and nvl(soi.term_date,v_lcl_date+1);
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 begin
 insert into order_item_attributes
 ( order_no,
 chapter_id,
 item_no,
 source_product_type,
 attrib_group,
 attrib_code,
 source_qty,
 program_id)
 select g_order_no,
 soa.chapter_id,
 soa.item_no,
 soi.product_type,
 soa.attrib_group,
 soa.attrib_code,
 soa.qty,
 'OEBSTORD'
 from valid_attributes va,
 standing_order_items soi,
 standing_order_attr soa
 where v_lcl_date between va.eff_date and
 nvl(va.term_date,v_lcl_date+1)
 and va.attrib_code = soa.attrib_code 
 and va.attrib_group = soa.attrib_group 
 and soi.item_no = soa.item_no 
 and soi.week_day = soa.week_day 
 and soi.chapter_id = soa.chapter_id 
 and soi.contract_id = soa.contract_id 
 and soi.consignee_id = soa.consignee_id 
 and v_lcl_date between soi.eff_date and
 nvl(soi.term_date,v_lcl_date+1)
 and soi.week_day = p_week_day
 and soi.chapter_id = p_chapter_id
 and soi.contract_id = p_contract_id
 and soi.consignee_id = p_consignee_id
 and va.unit_scheme_type = p_unit_scheme_type; 
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end; 
 
 copy('5','system.message_level');
 commit;
 copy('0','system.message_level');
 
 insert_params(p_chapter_id, g_order_no, usr_id);
 
 else
 message('Could not generate Order Number');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if; -- if fn_rslt = 'SUCCESS' then
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: REPORT_GENERATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE REPORT_GENERATE(pl_rep_name in varchar2, pl_parm_id in varchar2) IS
parameters VARCHAR2(150) := NULL;
 command VARCHAR2(200) := NULL;
 temp_return number;
 filename varchar2(1000);
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dest_parm'; 
 rep_dir varchar2(30);
 temp varchar2(40);
 a_port varchar2(40);
 --val varchar2(2000);
 repid REPORT_OBJECT;
 v_rep VARCHAR2(100);
 rep_status VARCHAR2(20);
 v_lcl_date date;
 
--for Apps server 
report_id Report_Object;
ReportServerJob VARCHAR2(100);
vc_rep_status VARCHAR2(100);
vjob_id VARCHAR2(100);

 -- Multiple reports server changes;
 l_svr_name VARCHAR2(70);
 l_err_msg VARCHAR2(200);
BEGIN 
 BEGIN 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id) ;
 end if ;

 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF; 
 END; 
 --message('number -1');

 if is_timezone_enabled
 then
 v_lcl_date := Lifetrack_Timezone_Convert.Get_Local_Time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate);
 else
 v_lcl_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 
/* Get the report server name from the master code table*/
/* -- Commented on 04/12/2012; Ashok; Below code moved to LTRepServer_Lab.pkg
 BEGIN
 Select code_desc into val 
 from master_codes 
 where code_type='OASVR' 
 and code='RPSVR'
 and v_lcl_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_lcl_date+1); 
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 message('Report server is not defined in the SYSPARM table for REPSVR');
 raise form_trigger_failure; 
 End; 
*/
--message('number -2');
 -- Added on 04/10/2012 to get least active jobs report server name.
 BC_CHECK_REPSERVER.get_reports_server( out_server_name => l_svr_name,
 out_error_msg => l_err_msg
 );

 IF l_err_msg IS NOT NULL THEN
 message('Err ' || l_err_msg);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 IF l_svr_name IS NULL THEN
 message('Error retrieving Server Name');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 ------------
--val:='rep_chdevsrv10_oracleas1'; 
--filename:=:rpt_parm.report_name||'_'||'_'||user;
 
filename:=pl_rep_name||'_'||pl_parm_id||'_'||LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid||'.pdf';
report_id:= find_report_object('LTREPORTS');
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_FILENAME,lower(pl_rep_name)); --'vdrinter.rdf');
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_COMM_MODE,ASYNCHRONOUS);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_EXECUTION_MODE,BATCH);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESTYPE,file);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESNAME,filename);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESFORMAT,'pdf');
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_SERVER,l_svr_name);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_OTHER, 'paramform=no');

 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_PARM_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,pl_parm_id) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'NO_OF_COPIES',TEXT_PARAMETER,'1');
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_CHAPTER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:global.chapter_id);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'PRINT_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,NULL);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'HEADER_YN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'N');
 --add_parameter(pl_id,'DELETE_AFTER_PRINT_FLAG',TEXT_PARAMETER,:rpt_parm.delete_after_print_flag);
 --add_parameter(pl_id,'AUTO_PRINT_FLAG',TEXT_PARAMETER,:rpt_parm.auto_print_flag);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'RPT_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,upper(pl_rep_name));
 --add_parameter(pl_id,'P_USER',TEXT_PARAMETER,upper(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid)); -- Commented by Kishore on 05/14/2012. IM 8618
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_USER',TEXT_PARAMETER,upper(:banner.user_id)); -- Added by Kishore on 05/14/2012. IM 8618
 
ReportServerJob:=run_report_object(report_id,pl_id);
vjob_id := substr(reportserverjob,length(l_svr_name)+2);
vc_rep_status := REPORT_OBJECT_STATUS(ReportServerJob);
--message('Status='||vc_rep_status);

message('Report Submitted ... ');
 
/* Commented on 04/12/2012; Ashok -- Only submit the report; Cronjob will update the status of the report
WHILE vc_rep_status in ('RUNNING','OPENING_REPORT','ENQUEUED', null)
LOOP
vc_rep_status:=REPORT_OBJECT_STATUS(ReportServerJob);
END LOOP;

--message('number -3');

IF vc_rep_status='FINISHED' THEN
 
 update rpt_parm set report_status = 'C'
 where user_name = decode(substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,1,3),'OPS',substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,5),LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid)
 and lower(report_name) = lower(pl_rep_name)
 and parm_id=pl_parm_id;

 --WEB.SHOW_DOCUMENT('/reports/rwservlet/getjobid'|| vjob_id ||'?server='||val,'_blank');
 if :global.msg_display = 'Y' then -- display message only once
 message('Report generated');
 end if;
ELSE
message ('Report failed with error message '|| vc_rep_status);
END IF;
*/

update rpt_parm 
 set rep_job_id = vjob_id,
 rep_server = l_svr_name
 where upper(report_name)=upper(pl_rep_name) 
 and user_name = decode(substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,1,3),'OPS',substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,5),LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid)
 and parm_id=pl_parm_id;
 
:system.message_level:=15;
commit; 
:system.message_level:=0;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE INSERT_PARAMS (p_chapter_id in varchar2,
 p_order_no in varchar2,
 p_usr_id in varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 begin 
 insert into rpt_parm 
 (appl_id,
 user_name,
 report_name,
 parm_id,
 parm_date,
 submit_date,
 report_status)
 values
 ('DON',
 p_usr_id,
 'OERORSLP',
 p_order_no,
 sysdate,
 sysdate,
 'E');
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 begin
 insert into rpt_parm_select
 (appl_id,
 user_name,
 report_name,
 parm_id,
 parm_no,
 parm_select,
 parm_code)
 values
 ('DON',
 p_usr_id,
 'OERORSLP',
 p_order_no,
 1,
 p_chapter_id,
 'CHP');
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 begin 
 insert into rpt_parm_select
 (appl_id,
 user_name,
 report_name,
 parm_id,
 parm_no,
 parm_select,
 parm_code)
 values
 ('DON',
 p_usr_id,
 'OERORSLP',
 p_order_no,
 2,
 p_order_no,
 'ORDNO');
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 copy('5','system.message_level');
 commit;
 copy('0','system.message_level');
 
 REPORT_GENERATE('oerorslp',p_order_no);
 
 if form_success then
 if :global.msg_display = 'Y' then -- display message only once
 show_error_dist('0000'); /* transaction committed */
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 else
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 show_error_dist('0600'); /* unsuccessful commit */
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
END;
